players.product: Glass wafers for supporting semiconductors (WSG carrier glass) and glass substrates for probe cards; inorganic core substrates (GC Core glass-ceramic core and glass core substrate) under joint development with semiconductor companies

quarterly_data.signal: Product: NEG developed 'BDX-3', a new Starveil ultra-thin cover glass for space applications that reduces radiation-induced discoloration and gives greater UV shielding than BDX-2, primarily for low Earth orbit but also usable in medium and high Earth orbit; samples are now available for purchase and NEG aims for commercial adoption in satellites and other spaceborne equipment.
